label: T schema: whatever is NECESSARY_2 (box of the route's frame) is true
paraphrase: OPEN modal principle, attribution deferred: the T schema 'necessarily p implies p' is valid on the route's modal frame (worlds = complete possible histories): for every proposition (every valuation of the sentence letter) and every world, if p holds at every world accessible from it, p holds there. The box is the frame's box, the same box as the route's NECESSARY_2 box-existence. By the T correspondence it is equivalent to reflexivity of the frame.
